The Earthshot Prize comes to India for the first time, with Mumbai chosen to host its sixth edition. Why Mumbai, and why is India critical to the global climate conversation? In an exclusive conversation, Earthshot Prize CEO Jason Knauf speaks to The Hindu's Vinaya Deshpande Pandit about India's role, the inspiration behind the awards and whether the initiative is achieving its climate ambitions.
Watch the conversation on Pulse Maharashtra with Vinaya Deshpande.
Thank you for watching our video!
